title: Iris (real CSV)
description: The classic Iris dataset — but loaded from the real CSV used by seaborn (not the sklearn Bunch). 150 samples, 4 features (sepal length, sepal width, petal length, petal width). Target: 3 species (setosa, versicolor, virginica). Useful as a sanity check that the CSV-loading pipeline produces identical numbers to sklearn's built-in version.
